name: qsdlc
description: Quintessence Software Development Lifecycle v2: a Continuous Software Factory skill library. Five stages (Plan, Design, Build, Test, Deploy) with track sizing, interactive stage gates or autonomous scheduled factory loops (draft PRs only, never auto-merge), two-stage review, verification maps, a correction-to-check ratchet, deterministic lint and safety guards, qsdlc-present and html-motion HTML artifacts, qsdlc-herdr multi-agent relay orchestration, and qsdlc-archify + qsdlc-graphify codebase diagram and knowledge-graph tools.
